panels.title: Goal status distribution
panels.description: Current goals by lifecycle status (active / proposed / blocked / completed). Source: goals table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(status='active') AS active, SUM(status='proposed') AS proposed, SUM(status='blocked') AS blocked, SUM(status='completed') AS completed FROM goals
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(status='active') AS active, SUM(status='proposed') AS proposed, SUM(status='blocked') AS blocked, SUM(status='completed') AS completed FROM goals

panels.title: Goal-run outcomes per day (14d)
panels.description: Daily goal_run outcome trend: completed vs error vs timeout. Reveals whether goal execution reliability is trending up or degrading. Source: goal_runs table (started_at, ISO-8601).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(status='completed') AS completed, SUM(status='error') AS errors, SUM(status='timeout') AS timeouts FROM goal_runs WHERE julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(status='completed') AS completed, SUM(status='error') AS errors, SUM(status='timeout') AS timeouts FROM goal_runs WHERE julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Goal-run success rate (14d)
panels.description: Share of goal_runs that completed (vs error/timeout) over the last 14 days. The headline reliability number behind the daily-outcomes trend.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status='completed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM goal_runs WHERE julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status='completed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM goal_runs WHERE julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Goal velocity — completed runs per day (14d)
panels.description: Throughput: number of goal_runs that completed each day. A simple velocity signal for how much autonomous goal work is actually landing.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT date(started_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS completed_runs FROM goal_runs WHERE status='completed' AND julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.queryText: SELECT date(started_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS completed_runs FROM goal_runs WHERE status='completed' AND julianday(started_at) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Goals (status / cadence / last run)
panels.description: Detail view of every goal with its current status, cadence, owner, and last-run outcome. Source: goals + goal_runs.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT g.id, g.intent, g.status, g.cadence, g.owner_staff_id, g.last_run_at, gr.status AS last_run_status FROM goals g LEFT JOIN goal_runs gr ON gr.id = (SELECT id FROM goal_runs WHERE goal_id=g.id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY CASE g.status WHEN 'blocked' THEN 0 WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'proposed' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, g.last_run_at DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT g.id, g.intent, g.status, g.cadence, g.owner_staff_id, g.last_run_at, gr.status AS last_run_status FROM goals g LEFT JOIN goal_runs gr ON gr.id = (SELECT id FROM goal_runs WHERE goal_id=g.id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY CASE g.status WHEN 'blocked' THEN 0 WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'proposed' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, g.last_run_at DESC

panels.title: Goal output verified — pass (range)
panels.description: Autonomy goal outputs that passed the LLM-as-judge verification gate before delivery (#tier2). Source: agent_events event='verification_pass'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS passed FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_pass' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS passed FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_pass' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Goal output verified — fail (range)
panels.description: Autonomy goal outputs the verification gate flagged as not accomplishing the task / unsupported (#tier2). Output is still delivered, annotated [unverified]. Source: agent_events event='verification_fail'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_fail' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_fail' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Goal verification outcomes per day
panels.description: Daily pass vs fail counts from the autonomy verification gate. Source: agent_events verification_pass / verification_fail.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='verification_pass') AS passed, SUM(event='verification_fail') AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('verification_pass','verification_fail') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='verification_pass') AS passed, SUM(event='verification_fail') AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('verification_pass','verification_fail') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent verification failures
panels.description: Most recent autonomy goal outputs flagged by the verification gate, with the critic's reason. Source: agent_events event='verification_fail'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(ts) AS ts, json_extract(detail,'$.goal_id') AS goal_id, json_extract(detail,'$.issue') AS issue FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_fail' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(ts) AS ts, json_extract(detail,'$.goal_id') AS goal_id, json_extract(detail,'$.issue') AS issue FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_fail' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Goal verification — skipped (by reason)
panels.description: Verifications that rendered NO verdict, broken out by reason (#837). 'disabled' / 'empty_output' are intentional bypasses; 'error' / 'unparseable' mean the critic ran but misbehaved (broken verifier). Logged as verification_skipped so they are NOT counted as passes. Source: agent_events event='verification_skipped'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT json_extract(detail,'$.reason') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS count, datetime(MAX(ts)) AS last_seen FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_skipped' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY count DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT json_extract(detail,'$.reason') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS count, datetime(MAX(ts)) AS last_seen FROM agent_events WHERE event='verification_skipped' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY count DESC
